descriptions.default: Only trusted commands (ls, cat, grep, git status, etc.) run automatically. Other commands are skipped. Can write to workspace.
descriptions.auto: A model classifier decides per tool call whether to approve or deny. Hands-off, but safer than Bypass — denials still happen.
descriptions.acceptEdits: All commands run automatically within the workspace. Full auto mode with sandboxed execution.
descriptions.bypassPermissions: Full system access with no restrictions. All commands run automatically with full disk and network access. Use with caution.
descriptions.plan: Planning mode - no commands are executed

rewrite.hint: Rewrite the last voice fragment with AI; review it before sending.
rewrite.recordFirst: Record a voice fragment first. Editing its draft invalidates the rewrite snapshot.
rewrite.notConfigured: AI rewrite is not configured on the Codey portal.
rewrite.restoreHint: Use the saved result without calling AI again.
rewrite.regenerateHint: Call AI again using the original voice text.
rewrite.optionsHint: Restore the last rewrite or generate a new one.
rewrite.busy: Rewriting… Your original text is kept.
rewrite.done: Rewritten. Review before sending; you can undo while the draft is unchanged.
rewrite.undone: Original voice text restored. You can restore the last rewrite without calling AI again.
rewrite.restored: Last rewrite restored without calling AI. Review before sending; you can still undo.
rewrite.cancelled: Rewrite cancelled. Your text is unchanged.
rewrite.draftChanged: The draft changed. The old snapshot will not overwrite your edits.
rewrite.copySuggestion: The draft changed. Copy any useful part of this suggestion manually.
rewrite.needsReview: Some wording is ambiguous. Your original text is kept; review this suggestion.
rewrite.failed: Rewrite failed. Your original text is unchanged.
rewrite.VOICE_REWRITE_NOT_CONFIGURED: AI rewrite is not configured on the Codey portal.

rewrite.VOICE_REWRITE_TIMEOUT: Rewrite timed out. Your original text is unchanged.

rewrite.VOICE_BUSY: Rewrite requests are busy. Please wait before retrying.
rewrite.VOICE_LOGIN_REQUIRED: Your Codey session expired. Sign in again; no rewrite was applied.
rewrite.VOICE_NODE_DENIED: Workspace access was revoked. No rewrite was applied.
